0238 'azan {a:-zan'}

字根型; TWOT - 57; 動詞

欽定本 - give ear 31, hearken 6, hear 3, perceived by the ear 1; 41

1) 聽, 留心聽
   1a) (Hiphil)
       1a1) 聽, 留心聽, 側耳
       1a2) 聽從, 留意
       1a3) (神) 垂聽 (禱告)

0238 'azan {aw-zan'}

a primitive root; TWOT - 57; v

AV - give ear 31, hearken 6, hear 3, perceived by the ear 1; 41

1) to hear, listen
   1a) (Hiphil)

       1a2) to be obedient, harken
       1a3) to hear or listen to prayers (of God)
